root_idea.summary: The root centers on directed aiming or recourse: heading toward a destination or revered object, and by extension a means of reaching or establishing a desired conclusion.
root_idea.development: The lexical branches include pilgrimage as a specialized act of directed travel, argument as a means by which the sought truth or victory is pursued, and probing a wound to reach knowledge of its depth. Other branches preserve distinct developments such as the year associated with an annual pilgrimage, the orbital bone, and retreat in reduplicated forms.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The public headword is normalized to the third-person masculine perfect citation form.
The Quranic form is plural حِجَج, presented under the supported singular citation form حِجَّة.

senses.definition: To perform the pilgrimage to Mecca and its prescribed rites.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic and legal usage denoting undertaking Hajj, the pilgrimage to the sacred House and the associated rites.

senses.definition: To contend with someone by argument, plea, proof, or evidence; to argue against an opponent.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction is relational, normally involving an opponent or disputing party; the contest may be described as argumentation in which one side prevails over the other, and may include litigation.

senses.definition: To dispute with one another by exchanging arguments, pleas, or proofs.
senses.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction describing mutual contention or disputation.

senses.definition: A pilgrim to Mecca; one performing the pilgrimage.
senses.usage_conditions: A substantivized active participle referring to a person engaged in or identified with the pilgrimage.

senses.definition: The pilgrimage to Mecca or the Kaaba, with its prescribed religious rites.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic noun for the pilgrimage observance; in one classical grammatical account, حَجّ is the verbal noun, while حِجّ is the corresponding substantive noun.

senses.definition: A year; in the plural, years.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the plural حِجَج, used for a number of years.

senses.definition: The pilgrimage to the sacred House.
senses.usage_conditions: A substantive noun for the pilgrimage; the sources distinguish it from حَجّ, which may function as the verbal noun.

senses.definition: An argument, proof, plea, or evidence used in reasoning or dispute.
senses.usage_conditions: It may denote a sound proof or a purported argument that is rejected; Quranic usage can call a defeated or false argument a حُجَّة while explicitly judging it invalid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To head or travel toward a person, place, or revered object; to visit, especially repeatedly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general directional or visiting use, broader than the specialized pilgrimage sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shave the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized action associated with completing pilgrimage rites, but also attested as a lexical use of the verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To probe a head fracture or wound, extract material from it, or treat it by the described probing procedure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A medical and surgical use concerning a wound or fracture reaching the head or brain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overcome another by an argument, plea, proof, evidence, or testimony.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the Form I resultative use in which the speaker prevails in a dispute.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refrain, forbear, or abstain from a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object of abstention is introduced with عن.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send someone to perform the pilgrimage to Mecca and its rites.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form IV usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adduce, urge, or defend oneself by means of an argument, plea, proof, evidence, or testimony.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The argument may be directed against an adversary or used in self-defense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To retreat or draw back, sometimes through fear or lack of power.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of withdrawing after an assault or of lacking the ability to continue.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refrain from saying what one intended, or to withhold what is in one's mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use concerning hesitation or failure to disclose an intended statement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, stay, or dwell in a place without leaving it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place is introduced with في.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the name Ḏū al-Ḥijjah, the month of pilgrimage; the word also occurs in an oath by the pilgrimage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are lexicalized expressions derived from the pilgrimage sense; the pilgrimage may also be called the greater pilgrimage in contrast with ʿumrah as the lesser pilgrimage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lobe of the ear; also its bore or perforation, or a bead or pearl hung in it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical and adornment use distinct from حُجَّة meaning an argument and from حِجَّة meaning a year.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An authoritative person or testimony serving as evidence; also an excuse or justification.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader application of the evidentiary noun beyond an argument in a formal dispute.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bone surrounding the eye, especially the upper orbital bone beneath the eyebrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun, grammatically masculine in the cited lexical description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper limb of the sun's disk as it begins to rise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or tropical extension of the orbital-bone sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A side of a mountain or other extended formation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical use, including the two sides of a mountain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person subjected to probing or treatment for a head fracture; also the treated fracture or the treatment itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same lexical family can denote the patient, the medically treated wound, or the treatment; its plural may refer to probed wounds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Roads deeply furrowed or heavily marked by the passage of people or animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a plural expression; the singular form is uncertain in the cited evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who overcomes another by arguments or proofs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial use related to حَاجَّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who frequently performs the pilgrimage and its prescribed rites.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive nominal description of repeated pilgrimage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One heading or betaking himself to a person or place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The general active-participle use, distinct from its substantivized sense ‘pilgrim’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who overcomes another by an argument or plea.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial use of the Form III disputative verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More capable of overcoming another by an argument or proof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative expression based on the evidentiary sense of حُجَّة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A road or way, especially the main, middle, or beaten track.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can denote the established route along which one travels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single uniform course or settled line for an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction extending the sense of a clear or single road.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A surgeon's probe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An instrument used for probing a wound or head fracture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person much addicted to litigation, dispute, or altercation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive nominal description of habitual disputation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person to whom someone has gone or paid a visit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial result of the general directional or visiting use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person overcome by an argument or proof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial result of disputation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A blow that is feeble or falls short.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived adjective associated with falling back or failing to reach its effect.

cautions: حَجّ and حِجّ are presented separately because the evidence distinguishes their vocalization and nominal usage, even though both denote the pilgrimage.
The plural Quranic form حِجَج is presented under the supported singular citation form حِجَّة, meaning a year.
The supplied Mufradat row mufradat:row:283 concerns حاجة/احتياج (‘need’) and is not assigned to the حجج root.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: mufradat:row:283 is lexically about حاجة and احتياج, with Quran citations to Yusuf 12:68 and al-Hashr 59:9; it does not provide evidence for the canonical حجج root and is therefore left unassigned.
